newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dutchman smuggles drugs into France in ambulance.
newsitem.headline: Dutchman smuggles drugs into France in ambulance.

text.p: French customs officers caught a Dutch smuggler driving an ambulance with almost half a tonne of cannabis stashed in the back, officials said on Monday.

The drugs were hidden in three compartments in the ambulance, intercepted in southwest France on Saturday just after the 38-year-old man drove the ambulance -- with no patient -- across the Spanish border.
The 483 kg (1,060 lb) of cannabis had an estimated street value of 500,000 francs ($81,000), officials said.

Customs officers in Dax, southwest France, also detained a British driver after finding 517 kg (1,140 lb) of cannabis resin hidden in his truck last week during a check at a motorway toll booth. ($ = 6.124 French Francs)
